stemMd: Which statement describes y = 3^x for all real x?

options.label: B
options.textMd: It is undefined for every noninteger x.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Its values can be negative for negative x.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Its values are positive and it is strictly increasing.

explanationMd: A positive base raised to any real power remains positive. Since the base three exceeds one, increasing the exponent increases the value. At zero the value is one, and negative exponents give positive fractions.

distractorRationale.c: Any nonzero base to power zero equals one.
distractorRationale.a: An exponential with base greater than one increases.
distractorRationale.b: A positive-base exponential is defined for all real x.
